english.notes:
(i) Statutory requirement for corroboration (section 13).
(ii) This offence may be applied in relation to existing registers of doctors, dentists, veterinary surgeons, pharmacists, nurses, mid wifes and health visitors. It will also apply to any professional registers which may be established in the future.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
